row_semantics_rule: row existence may be used as t0 historical absence of spp.name on holmkod because the archived table is documented as potential colonization events; outcome token remains opaque

historical_source_reconstruction.island_universe: freeze all unique holmkod values from the t0 projection
historical_source_reconstruction.species_universe: freeze all unique spp.name values from the t0 projection
historical_source_reconstruction.t0_occupied_pairs: complement of t0_absent_pairs within the frozen island x species universe
historical_source_reconstruction.validation: historical source counts must be internally consistent within species and with documented Historical_total_log semantics where transform can be verified response-independently

anti_leakage: do not parse, normalize, count, summarize or persist outcome tokens during t0 projection
do not select islands or species from outcome
do not use the published AIC-simplified model as an outcome-selected reference specification
do not use future colonization success to choose graph scale, spatial blocks, rarity threshold or null topology ensemble
success_ceiling: authorize t0-only projection and reconstruction contract; future outcome remains sealed
